_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoked: Here is a train search link

description: Return a train or bus search handoff between two cities, routed by region. Asian routes open 12Go with the route and date prefilled. European routes open the Omio route page (Madrid-Barcelona opens a prefilled search; Tokyo-Kyoto also gets the Omio page). Routes in other regions, such as the Americas, return no handoff. Confirm dates and passengers on the partner site; the card preserves the requested date for reference. No live fares, availability, or tickets are provided.

currency.description: Optional ISO-style three-letter display currency, such as EUR. Omit to use the user's preferred currency, then the currency of the trip given by trip_id, then EUR.

departureDate.description: Local departure date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

returnDate.description: Optional return date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

trip_id.description: Optional Tineo trip ID (from trips_list) this request is for. Used only to default the currency to that trip's currency when currency is omitted and the user has no preferred currency; ignored if the trip is not found or not accessible to the user.

name: train_booking_link
